notes: Top and bottom dimensions are dimension chains along different perimeter runs; do not assume all internal rooms are rectangular.
The third drawing is the dimension reference; the second black-and-white drawing is the wall and opening reference.
Trace wall centerlines segment by segment, preserving offsets, recesses, structural cores, stair/entry geometry and non-rectangular perimeter.
Net room areas must be computed from traced room polygons after wall thickness is defined.
Do not claim construction-grade accuracy for any unmarked opening or wall thickness.
